items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Across the street was the Grand Theater that had Dave Payton but they were more classical, they were more minstrel type of playing.

ctx.x: Now is that the biggest black theater?
The black theater and it was just fabulous. Across the street was the Grand Theater that had Dave Payton but they were more classical, they were more minstrel type of playing.
Really? The difference in Payton… what did they play? You say classical, in what respect?
